import BusyBeaver.ZFC.TablePrefix250
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkPerm252

/-!
Concrete marking on the exact prefix250 table. Pure unary encodings and the
state-count-generic return scanner are reused from the maintained permutation252
proof; every concrete row is checked again on the new table.

The contract is attributed to Mira-Cult, Jeff Ketchersid and Wade, via
mira-emmy PR20 head 0d544f2a2e3c18f12278441a74b7879f31cbe856 and the
maintained RegisterMarkPerm252 proof. Arbitrary values, suffixes, and left
contexts are preserved; no bootstrap or full instruction theorem is claimed.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkPrefix250

open FiniteZipper ZipperRuns RegisterBoxesPerm252

/-- The nine selectors in increasing physical-register order. -/
def skip : Nat → Fin 250
  | 0 => oldStatePrefix250 60
  | 1 => oldStatePrefix250 44
  | 2 => oldStatePrefix250 31
  | 3 => oldStatePrefix250 56
  | 4 => oldStatePrefix250 38
  | 5 => oldStatePrefix250 40
  | 6 => oldStatePrefix250 28
  | 7 => oldStatePrefix250 64
  | _ => oldStatePrefix250 69

def restoreZero : Fin 250 := oldStatePrefix250 0
def markFirst : Fin 250 := oldStatePrefix250 2
def markReturnOnes : Fin 250 := oldStatePrefix250 4
def markReturnZero : Fin 250 := oldStatePrefix250 6

theorem skip_one_facts : ∀ j : Fin 9,
    machinePrefix250.transition (skip j.val) true = ⟨true, .right, some (skip j.val)⟩ := by decide +kernel

theorem skip_next_facts : ∀ j : Fin 8,
    machinePrefix250.transition (skip (j.val + 1)) false =
      ⟨false, .right, some (skip j.val)⟩ := by decide +kernel

theorem row_skip_target :
    machinePrefix250.transition (skip 0) false = ⟨false, .right, some restoreZero⟩ := by decide +kernel
theorem row_erase_one :
    machinePrefix250.transition restoreZero true = ⟨false, .left, some markFirst⟩ := by decide +kernel
theorem row_mark_back :
    machinePrefix250.transition markFirst false = ⟨false, .left, some markFirst⟩ := by decide +kernel
theorem row_mark_enter :
    machinePrefix250.transition markFirst true = ⟨true, .left, some markReturnOnes⟩ := by decide +kernel
theorem row_mark_return_one :
    machinePrefix250.transition markReturnOnes true =
      ⟨true, .left, some markReturnOnes⟩ := by decide +kernel
theorem row_mark_return_zero :
    machinePrefix250.transition markReturnOnes false =
      ⟨false, .left, some markReturnZero⟩ := by decide +kernel
theorem row_mark_return_probe :
    machinePrefix250.transition markReturnZero true =
      ⟨true, .left, some markReturnOnes⟩ := by decide +kernel

theorem skip_block (j : Nat) (hj : j < 8) (v : Nat) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250 (zAt (skip (j + 1)) h l
      (false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ X))) (v + 2) =
      zAt (skip j) (h + ((v + 2 : Nat) : Int))
        (List.replicate (v + 1) true ++ false :: l) X := by
  rw [show v + 2 = (v + 1) + 1 by omega, zipRun_first,
    step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (skip_next_facts ⟨j, hj⟩)]
  change zipRun machinePrefix250
    (zAt (skip j) (h + 1) (false :: l) (List.replicate (v + 1) true ++ X)) (v + 1) = _
  rw [scan_right _ _ _ (skip_one_facts ⟨j, by omega⟩)]
  congr 1
  omega

theorem skip_file (pre : List Nat) (m : Nat) (hm : pre.length + m < 9)
    (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250 (zAt (skip (pre.length + m)) h l (registerBits pre ++ X))
      (width pre) =
      zAt (skip m) (h + (width pre : Int)) ((registerBits pre).reverse ++ l) X := by
  induction pre generalizing h l with
  | nil => simp [registerBits, width, zipRun]
  | cons v pre ih =>
    simp only [width, registerBits, List.length_cons, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]
    rw [show pre.length + 1 + m = (pre.length + m) + 1 by omega,
      zipRun_add, skip_block (pre.length + m) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hm; omega), ih (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hm; omega)]
    simp only [List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_replicate,
      List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append, List.replicate_succ']
    congr 1
    omega

theorem mark_steps (v : Nat) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250 (zAt (skip 0) h l (false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ X))) 3 =
      leftAt markFirst h l (false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ X)) := by
  rw [zipRun_first, step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ row_skip_target,
    zipRun_first, step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ row_erase_one, leftAt_cons,
    zipRun_first, step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ row_mark_back]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

def markExit (pre : List Nat) : Fin 250 :=
  if pre = [] then markFirst else markReturnZero

/-- Mark with an arbitrary terminal word, so both unpadded and explicitly
padded whole-file contracts are immediate clients. -/
theorem mark_word (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (hp : pre.length < 9)
    (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250
      (zAt (skip pre.length) h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ X)))
      (2 * width pre + 3) =
      leftAt (markExit pre) h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ X)) := by
  rw [show 2 * width pre + 3 = width pre + (3 + width pre) by omega,
    zipRun_add]
  have forward := skip_file pre 0 (by simpa using hp) h l
    (false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ X))
  simp only [Nat.add_zero] at forward
  rw [forward, zipRun_add, mark_steps]
  by_cases he : pre = []
  · subst pre
    simp [width, registerBits, zipRun, markExit]
  · rw [RegisterMarkPerm252.return_end machinePrefix250 markReturnOnes
      markReturnZero row_mark_return_one row_mark_return_zero
      row_mark_return_probe pre he markFirst row_mark_enter]
    simp only [markExit, if_neg he]
    congr 1
    omega

/-- Unpadded register-file contract, including every finite spare suffix. -/
theorem mark_zip (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (hp : pre.length < 9) (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250
      (zAt (skip pre.length) h l (registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest)))
      (2 * width pre + 3) =
      leftAt (markExit pre) h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false ::
          (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest)) := by
  simpa only [registerBits_append, registerBits] using
    mark_word pre v hp h l (registerBits rest)

/-- Whole-tape Core semantics; no fixed false padding is required. -/
theorem mark {c : Config 250} (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (hp : pre.length < 9) (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt (skip pre.length) h l (registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest)))) :
    ZipRep (machinePrefix250.runFrom c (2 * width pre + 3))
      (leftAt (markExit pre) h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false ::
          (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest))) := by
  have hs := zipRun_sound machinePrefix250 (2 * width pre + 3) hc
  rw [mark_zip pre v rest hp] at hs
  exact hs

/-- The same execution with an arbitrary explicitly represented terminal word. -/
theorem mark_with_suffix {c : Config 250} (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat)
    (hp : pre.length < 9) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt (skip pre.length) h l
      (registerBits pre ++ false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ X)))) :
    ZipRep (machinePrefix250.runFrom c (2 * width pre + 3))
      (leftAt (markExit pre) h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ X))) := by
  have hs := zipRun_sound machinePrefix250 (2 * width pre + 3) hc
  rw [mark_word pre v hp] at hs
  exact hs

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkPrefix250

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkPrefix250

open SetTheory.BusyBeaver SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
open RegisterMarkPrefix250 RegisterBoxesPerm252 FiniteZipper ZipperRuns

#print axioms skip_one_facts
#print axioms skip_next_facts
#print axioms skip_file
#print axioms mark_steps
#print axioms mark_word
#print axioms mark_zip
#print axioms mark
#print axioms mark_with_suffix

example (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat) (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250
      (zAt (skip 0) h l (registerBits (v :: rest))) 3 =
    leftAt markFirst h l (false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest)) := by
  simpa only [List.length_nil, width, registerBits, List.nil_append, markExit,
    if_pos rfl, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_add] using
    mark_zip [] v rest (by decide) h l

example (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat) (hp : pre.length < 9)
    (hne : pre ≠ []) (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250
      (zAt (skip pre.length) h l (registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest)))
      (2 * width pre + 3) =
    leftAt markReturnZero h l
      (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest)) := by
  simpa only [markExit, if_neg hne] using mark_zip pre v rest hp h l

example {c : Config 250} (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (hp : pre.length < 9) (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt (skip pre.length) h l (registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest)))) :
    ZipRep (machinePrefix250.runFrom c (2 * width pre + 3))
      (leftAt (markExit pre) h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest))) :=
  mark pre v rest hp h l hc

example (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat) (hp : pre.length < 9)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250
      (zAt (skip pre.length) h l (registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest) ++ [false]))
      (2 * width pre + 3) =
    leftAt (markExit pre) h l
      (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest ++ [false])) := by
  simpa only [registerBits_append, registerBits, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc] using
    mark_word pre v hp h l (registerBits rest ++ [false])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded exact250 marking proof; seven selected project providers, no rebuild.
The table PASS record pin must be frozen after the root's successful table run.
Prepare-only performs no compiler or version invocation. Proof mode compiles
only RegisterMarkPrefix250 and its focused audit, serially, with a fresh output object.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, time

MODULE = 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkPrefix250'
PREFIX = 'SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkPrefix250.'
SOURCE_SHA = '76feb52843e7fd4e87a6da020e8116049cf5d2809be6013f6e020991c6d62ad7'
AUDIT_SHA = 'a9534bf863a422e7370d7502e6440fe10d4e2f725b585cc1b9f76cb929b26252'
TABLE_RECORD_SHA = '5a8724f11bb54623a271ed54f4e58fa285dc9debab6a19403b949e30607f4767'
MP_RECORD_SHA = '92c2bddc7390806e81b30daa15c2bcfe082dcae6555392a57fe6d1ae987df81b'
EXPECTED = {
    'BusyBeaver.Core': ('436336133fa107c62eb00322333ec9451a0705964bd2b62fce3f44ce848672a6', '2c18d0fc971038cdd3cf5998857f56a88ea1cf33cd11f90f6794866fcc2e1148'),
    'BusyBeaver.ZFC.FiniteZipper': ('f7b41631975f0c243bcb6e48a6c566adde0866fb93f7105571e310c18db45066', 'bfbfb31d4cd560b52a65a832777d64f544dc6a1bbbb080829cc1465881d44101'),
    'BusyBeaver.ZFC.ZipperRuns': ('fc8f39330f6551fb2b29db22127efbb361dd421290b47ca95d1088d7104a3d48', 'f6280bb230bb5f816c27fcd7789aa16a3890d5a0ac3c0d74bd4ac9a19006e8b6'),
    'BusyBeaver.ZFC.TablePerm252': ('d216d7292acf690095048024e2cae2575195ded015acf8e235261b8152e74bd0', '62f26b312a448576ae3b83dbeb336a844fbcf9e1341e67aec79114e553dd67c3'),
    'BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterBoxesPerm252': ('da0a5c460aba89b9d46dc794fad70a98ac441238ed26c5f7287fa4797a0bd5e7', 'ca74f3f602f975958c6c316071dfc151d1b73d4dcc33c34ce19bc8b07fe76c3e'),
    'BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkPerm252': ('c646007b54f2d32242f593a60eb770834f3e085a03ee60beb1275aebb796ce41', '6d661f5afac61d31ae82fe20e5c2420216fe2bdb866dbabf5572455061df200c'),
}
PROBES = ['skip_one_facts', 'skip_next_facts', 'skip_file', 'mark_steps',
          'mark_word', 'mark_zip', 'mark', 'mark_with_suffix']
CALLERS = 4
TIMEOUT = 120

p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('--repo', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--table-evidence', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--source', type=Path)
p.add_argument('--audit', type=Path)
p.add_argument('--prepare-only', action='store_true')
a = p.parse_args()
if not __debug__:
    p.error('Assertions must remain enabled.')
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
R = a.repo.resolve()
W = a.output.resolve()
assert not W.is_relative_to(R) and (not W.exists() or not any(W.iterdir()))
assert TABLE_RECORD_SHA != 'PENDING_SUCCESSFUL_TABLE_RECORD', 'Freeze successful table evidence before preparation or compilation.'
S = a.source.resolve() if a.source else Path('/tmp/zfc-prefix250-lean/retiming/mark/RegisterMarkPrefix250.lean')
A = a.audit.resolve() if a.audit else Path('/tmp/zfc-prefix250-lean/retiming/mark/Audit.lean')
assert sha(S) == SOURCE_SHA and sha(A) == AUDIT_SHA
E = a.table_evidence.resolve()
MP = R / 'Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/results/arithmetic-control-mp254-verification.json'
assert sha(E) == TABLE_RECORD_SHA and sha(MP) == MP_RECORD_SHA
parent, mp = json.loads(E.read_text()), json.loads(MP.read_text())
for d in (parent, mp):
    assert d['status'] == 'PASS' and d['only_standard_axioms']
    assert d['all_input_provider_postchecks'] and d['all_fresh_objects_unchanged_after_audit']
    assert len(d['commands']) == 2 and all(q['exit_code'] == 0 for q in d['commands'])
    assert [q['label'] for q in d['commands']] == ['source', 'audit']
C = Path(parent['compiler']['path']).resolve()
assert parent['compiler']['sha256'] == mp['compiler']['sha256'] == sha(C)
assert parent['compiler']['version'] == mp['compiler']['version']
version = parent['compiler']['version']
toolroot = C.parent.parent / 'lib/lean'

def imports(path):
    text = Path(path).read_text()
    return re.findall(r'^import\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)\s*$', text, re.M)

assert imports(S) == ['BusyBeaver.ZFC.TablePrefix250', 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkPerm252']
assert imports(A) == [MODULE]
assert re.findall(r'^#print axioms (\S+)$', A.read_text(), re.M) == PROBES
assert len(re.findall(r'^example\b', A.read_text(), re.M)) == CALLERS
# Reject new unchecked proof exits and enlarged elaboration budgets.
for f in (S, A):
    assert not re.search(r'\b(sorry|admit|native_decide)\b', f.read_text())
    assert not re.search(r'set_option\s+(maxHeartbeats|maxRecDepth)', f.read_text())
pool = {q['module']: q for q in mp['reused_modules']}
selected = {}
for m, (source_sha, object_sha) in EXPECTED.items():
    q = pool[m]
    source = R / 'Computability/BusyBeaver/Lean' / Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.lean')
    obj = Path(q['object']).resolve()
    assert q['source_sha256'] == source_sha == sha(source)
    assert q['object_sha256'] == object_sha == sha(obj)
    selected[m] = dict(module=m, source=str(source), source_sha256=source_sha,
                       object=str(obj), object_sha256=object_sha, evidence=str(MP))
fresh = [q for q in parent['fresh_modules'] if q['module'] == 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.TablePrefix250']
assert len(fresh) == 1
q = fresh[0]
table_source = Path(parent['source']['path']).resolve()
table_snapshot = Path(parent['source']['snapshot']).resolve()
assert q['source_sha256'] == parent['source']['sha256'] == sha(table_source) == sha(table_snapshot)
table_object = Path(q['path']).resolve()
assert sha(table_object) == q['sha256']
selected[q['module']] = dict(module=q['module'], source=str(table_source),
    source_sha256=sha(table_source), object=str(table_object), object_sha256=sha(table_object), evidence=str(E))
# The fresh table must have used the identical Core import selected here.
parent_core = next(q for q in parent['reused_modules'] if q['module'] == 'BusyBeaver.Core')
assert (parent_core['source_sha256'], parent_core['object_sha256']) == EXPECTED['BusyBeaver.Core']
visiting, closure, tool_names = set(), [], {'Init'}
def visit(m):
    if m in closure:
        return
    assert m in selected and m not in visiting
    visiting.add(m)
    for n in imports(selected[m]['source']):
        if n == 'Init' or n.startswith(('Lean.', 'Std.')):
            tool_names.add(n)
        else:
            visit(n)
    visiting.remove(m)
    closure.append(m)
for m in imports(S):
    visit(m)
assert set(closure) == set(selected) and len(closure) == 7
W.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
cache, snap = W / 'cache', W / 'sources'
cache.mkdir()
ss = snap / Path(MODULE.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.lean')
ss.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
aa = snap / 'Audit.lean'
shutil.copyfile(S, ss)
shutil.copyfile(A, aa)
for m in closure:
    dest = cache / Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest.symlink_to(selected[m]['object'])
def first(m):
    rel = Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    return next(q / rel for q in (cache, toolroot) if (q / rel).is_file())
actual = []
for m in closure:
    obj = first(m)
    assert sha(obj) == selected[m]['object_sha256']
    actual.append(dict(module=m, actual_first=str(obj), resolved=str(obj.resolve()), sha256=sha(obj)))
tools = []
for m in sorted(tool_names):
    ref = toolroot / Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    obj = first(m)
    assert obj.resolve() == ref.resolve()
    tools.append(dict(module=m, object=str(ref), object_sha256=sha(ref), actual_first=str(obj)))

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkPrefix250

open SetTheory.BusyBeaver SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
open RegisterMarkPrefix250 RegisterBoxesPerm252 FiniteZipper ZipperRuns

#print axioms skip_one_facts
#print axioms skip_next_facts
#print axioms skip_file
#print axioms mark_steps
#print axioms mark_word
#print axioms mark_zip
#print axioms mark
#print axioms mark_with_suffix

example (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat) (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250
      (zAt (skip 0) h l (registerBits (v :: rest))) 3 =
    leftAt markFirst h l (false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest)) := by
  simpa only [List.length_nil, width, registerBits, List.nil_append, markExit,
    if_pos rfl, if_true, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_add] using
    mark_zip [] v rest (by decide) h l

example (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat) (hp : pre.length < 9)
    (hne : pre ≠ []) (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250
      (zAt (skip pre.length) h l (registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest)))
      (2 * width pre + 3) =
    leftAt markReturnZero h l
      (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest)) := by
  simpa only [markExit, if_neg hne] using mark_zip pre v rest hp h l

example {c : Config 250} (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (hp : pre.length < 9) (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt (skip pre.length) h l (registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest)))) :
    ZipRep (machinePrefix250.runFrom c (2 * width pre + 3))
      (leftAt (markExit pre) h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest))) :=
  mark pre v rest hp h l hc

example (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat) (hp : pre.length < 9)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250
      (zAt (skip pre.length) h l (registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest) ++ [false]))
      (2 * width pre + 3) =
    leftAt (markExit pre) h l
      (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest ++ [false])) := by
  simpa only [registerBits_append, registerBits, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc] using
    mark_word pre v hp h l (registerBits rest ++ [false])
